articles.title: Noel Tata steps down as Tata Investment Chairman after 16 years; Bahram Vakil to take over
articles.summary: Noel Tata joined the board of Tata Investment Corporation on June 9, 2004, and became Chairman on June 24, 2010. His retirement brings to an end a board tenure spanning more than 22 years

articles.title: 'RBI may struggle to meet 4% inflation target': Economist flags fastest money, credit growth since 2012-13
articles.summary: I worry we are underestimating the risk of persistent inflation while focusing our policy efforts on pushing the rupee higher, says ISB professor Prasanna Tantri

articles.title: Amul to raise milk prices from Thursday; Nandini, Mother Dairy also hike prices
articles.summary: Higher cattle feed, fodder, packaging and fuel costs, along with increased payouts to farmers, are driving milk price hikes across India

articles.title: Sensex has rallied nearly 12%: Is it time to relook at your investment strategy?
articles.summary: There has been a sudden turnaround in sentiment since late October and Indian equities have seen a series of upgrades in the last few days from global brokerages as well.

articles.title: Gaurav Munjal steps down as Unacademy CEO, Akhilendra Kumar takes charge
articles.summary: Munjal said he would remain closely involved in daily operations and support the proposed IPO of parent company upGrad

articles.title: Cement trader deposited Rs 14.74 lakh during demonetisation; gets tax notice but wins ITAT relief
articles.summary: The Income Tax Assessing Officer (AO) in Balasore questioned the deposit and estimated the cement trader’s sales by comparing his business activity before and after demonetisation in 2016.

articles.title: Air India loss share declines but fuel bites Singapore Airlines group as H1 profit falls 44% to Rs 767 crore
Salman Khan's reported ₹120 crore Bigg Boss 20 fee works out to about ₹8 crore a weekend
articles.summary: Salman Khan is reportedly paid about ₹120 crore for Bigg Boss 20. Spread across a 15-week season, that is roughly ₹8 crore a weekend. Who is left, and who has gone.

articles.title: Crude down 24%, FPIs invest ₹53,739 crore: GTRI explains what's driving rupee recovery
articles.summary: A 24% fall in crude oil prices and ₹53,739 crore in foreign investor inflows have eased pressure on the Indian rupee. GTRI expects the currency to strengthen towards ₹92–93 per dollar if favourable trends continue.

articles.title: Ramayana made ₹440 crore in six days, more than Animal's whole first week
articles.summary: Ramayana made ₹440.45 crore net in six days, already ₹103 crore more than Animal's full first week. We line up the opening-week numbers of Hindi cinema's biggest films.

articles.title: Russia's oil game runs dry as Ukrainian drones knock out 30% of refining capacity
articles.summary: Ukrainian drone strikes have hit nine major Russian oil refineries, cutting their processing capacity by about 30%. These refineries usually handle around 300,000 metric tonnes of crude oil every day.

articles.title: Indian airlines operated fewer flights this Diwali; here’s why
articles.summary: IndiGo, the country’s largest carrier, also reduced capacity by 1% and carried 4.5% fewer passengers in the quarter ended September.

articles.title: ₹2.51 a km by train, about ₹5 a km by air: Bengaluru-Mumbai travel compared
articles.summary: The new sleeper train costs ₹2,810 in AC 3-tier for 1,118 km, about ₹2.51 a km. A flight costs more but saves about 14 hours. We compare cost, time and comfort.

articles.title: Will October inflation breach 6%? What it means for interest rates, EMIs and GDP growth
articles.summary: Rising food prices could push retail inflation to a two-year high, breaching the RBI’s comfort zone and raising the prospect of interest rate hikes.

articles.title: Rs 30 lakh insurance claim rejected over ‘alcohol consumption’; family wins payout with interest
articles.summary: The family contested the insurer's decision before the District Consumer Commission, Vellore. The insurer was also ordered to pay annual interest at 9% from September 1, 2023, until the date of the District Commission's order.

articles.title: India's GDP growth to beat RBI forecast? SBI sees 7.8% expansion in Q2; Moody's raises FY27 outlook
articles.summary: According to SBI Research, India's economic activity remained robust during July–September 2026, supported by manufacturing, services, corporate profitability and accelerating bank credit.

articles.title: Moody’s raises India’s FY27 growth forecast to 7% on strong economic momentum
articles.summary: Moody's Ratings has revised its growth forecast for India to 7% for the current financial year. The rating agency noted India's resilience to energy supply shocks and broad-based economic momentum.

articles.title: India bans battery scrap exports to boost domestic recovery of critical minerals
articles.summary: Move aims to ease feedstock shortages for domestic recyclers as India generates less than 15,000 metric tonnes (MT) of black mass annually against over 60,000 MT of refining capacity

articles.title: Indian Railways steps up cleanliness checks on trains with journey of over 40 hours
articles.summary: Officials have said that 11 trains have been selected under the initiative, with staff required to take photographs of coaches and toilets bearing time stamps at the starting station, destination and specified inspection points along the route.

articles.title: AQI 299 to 376: What Delhi’s air around Diwali equals in cigarettes, day by day
articles.summary: One cigarette a day equals 22 µg/m³ of PM2.5, says Berkeley Earth. Around Diwali, Delhi’s daily AQI of 299 to 376 worked out to about 5-10 cigarettes.

articles.title: ‘It’s been a world war’: Sunil Bharti Mittal says Indian telecom sector has been a real battleground
articles.summary: Sunil Bharti Mittal said he was of the view that Airtel did not have the resources to “match anywhere” close to Jio. He believed it would be for the best if they lied low and let the storm pass.

articles.title: India-UK trade deal hits tariff hurdle: Customs seeks 150% duty on bulk Scotch, shipments held at ports
articles.summary: India's first major tariff dispute under the India-UK trade pact has left dozens of bulk Scotch shipments stranded at ports, with customs authorities demanding 150% duty instead of the agreed 75%.

articles.title: India-UK trade deal faces early test as customs hold scotch imports over tariff row
articles.summary: Indian customs authorities are holding containers of bulk Scotch whisky due to a tariff dispute involving Pernod Ricard and Diageo. Authorities insist these shipments are subject to a 150% import duty despite trade pact assurances.

Mother Dairy, Amul hike milk rates by upto Rs 6 per litre from tomorrow; check prices
articles.summary: As of November 12, milk prices in the Delhi-NCR region are set to rise as Mother Dairy and Amul implement increases ranging from Rs 2 to Rs 6 across their milk variants.

‘De-risk, not decouple’: Bessent says US-China must cooperate on AI risks
articles.summary: The United States and China plan to initiate a dialogue on superintelligence risks during an upcoming meeting. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent highlighted the importance of cooperation in managing artificial intelligence risks.

Crude cools off: Oil prices hold near $90 per barrel as US-Iran war tensions ease
articles.summary: Recent trends reveal that oil prices have settled around $90 per barrel, reflecting a decrease in tensions between the US and Iran. This cooling has alleviated concerns over possible supply shortages in the Middle East.

articles.title: Quote of the Day by Steve Jobs: 'Innovation distinguishes between a leader and a follower'
articles.summary: Steve Jobs (1955-2011) was an American entrepreneur, inventor, and business magnate best known as the co-founder of Apple. Jobs played a key role in revolutionising personal computing, smartphones, digital music, and animation.

articles.title: FIIs invest $22 billion in IPOs, dump $50 billion in listed stocks: Why the sharp contrast?
articles.summary: Foreign investors invested $22 billion in India's primary market but withdrew $50 billion from listed stocks over two years, Motilal Oswal reported. The sharp divergence raises questions about why FIIs favour new share issuances while continuing to sell existing equities.

articles.title: Luxembourg tops list of world's most trade-dependent countries; India ranks 139th
articles.summary: Luxembourg benefits from its financial services industry, while Singapore serves as a major international trading and re-export hub

articles.title: Builder withheld Rs 88 lakh after redevelopment deal; landowners win over Rs 1.22 crore
articles.summary: The dispute originated in 2010, when two landowners, along with their late mother, transferred their development rights to a builder for redevelopment. They held a one-third undivided share in a property in Mumbai, and executed an Agreement to Assign for the redevelopment.

articles.title: Shriram General Insurance premium income jumps 21% in H1FY27, outpaces industry growth of 9%
articles.summary: Shriram General Insurance reported a nearly 21% increase in gross direct premium income during the first half of FY27, significantly outperforming the general insurance industry's 9% growth.

articles.title: UPI payments above ₹2,000 to attract 0.4% MDR after Diwali? Who pays, who is exempt and when charges begin
articles.summary: The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) had originally scheduled the new Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) framework for October 15, 2026. However, its UPI and Services Steering Committee deferred implementation on October 13, citing the festive season.

articles.title: How much Venezuela oil can India realistically buy as Russia remains biggest supplier?

articles.title: Indian Railways rolls out Vande Bharat sleeper trains in 2026, plans some more soon
articles.summary: Vande Bharat sleeper trains are fully air-conditioned overnight train services that have been designed to offer superior comforts to Rajdhani Express trains, while also reducing travel time with higher average speeds.

articles.title: Australian airline Qantas to axe 850 jobs at HQ, shift work to India
articles.summary: Qantas is planning to outsource around 850 head-office jobs to Accenture, significantly affecting its Australian workforce. This transition will involve business functions like finance, human resources, and marketing being delivered from India.

articles.title: Man sold properties for Rs 47.54 lakh in cash & paid capital gains tax, but faced penalty; what ITAT ruled
articles.summary: The case concerned a man in Odisha who, according to the submissions before the tribunal, sold two properties for a combined consideration of around Rs 47.54 lakh. However, for this sale he received the entire amount in cash.

articles.title: Asian stocks rally as Wall Street rebounds, oil prices ease
articles.summary: Asian stock markets rallied on Tuesday as US stocks experienced a significant rebound on the previous day. Notably, Japan's Nikkei 225 saw a 2.6% rise while South Korea's Kospi climbed 4%.
